backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the e-commerce backend, defining types and state for products, orders, users, and site settings (including Razorpay and WhatsApp), with admin access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the hero background image replacement feature to the Hero.tsx file and associated components/test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend source files describing the purpose and key behaviors of each component, page, and hook in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, loading Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Lato), the Razorpay checkout script, and the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application file that sets up TanStack Router with all customer and admin routes, wraps the app in QueryClient/ThemeProvider/CartProvider, and renders FloatingWhatsApp on all customer-facing pages via CustomerLayout.
frontend/src/components/AboutAyurveda.ts: Animated section component explaining Ayurveda's philosophy and the three doshas, using IntersectionObserver to trigger slide-in animations for left and right content columns.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: Route guard component that verifies Internet Identity authentication and admin status before rendering children, redirecting to the login page or showing a timeout/loading state as needed.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar navigation (desktop and mobile), brand header, nav links for Dashboard/Products/Orders/Users/Settings, and a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: Admin UI component that simulates AI image generation by mapping a text prompt to a curated Unsplash botanical image, with a preview and a button to apply the selected image.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: Modal dialog for viewing order details including customer/shipping info, payment status, and a dropdown to update fulfillment status via the useUpdateFulfillmentStatus mutation.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: Modal form for creating or editing a product, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, image upload, AI image generation, featured flag, status, and dynamic key-value specifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: Read-only modal dialog that displays a user's profile details including name, email, principal ID, registration date, and total order count.
frontend/src/components/AyurvedicHeroAni: Component file for an Ayurvedic hero animation (content truncated/empty in the provided source).
frontend/src/components/Benefits.tsx: Renders a section of six benefit cards (e.g., 100% Natural, Chemical-Free) with icons and descriptions, each animating into view via IntersectionObserver scroll detection.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out cart drawer using a Sheet component that displays cart items with quantity controls and a checkout button, powered by the CartContext.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Displays a grid of featured products fetched via a React Query hook, with skeleton loading states and a link to the full shop page.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button that fetches the business phone number from the backend and opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link, with entrance animation and a hover tooltip.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand info, social media icons, quick navigation links, product links, and contact details, styled with the forest/cream color theme.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a Ken Burns background image, layered gradient overlays, animated brand name, tagline, and CTA buttons that fade in on mount.
A slide-in mobile navigation drawer component with links to Home and Shop, plus a login/logout button, rendered as an overlay when open.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, a cart icon with item count badge, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, status badges, price, and Add to Cart / Buy Now action buttons, navigating to the product detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: Invisible utility component that seeds the backend with sample products when the product list is empty on mount.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Renders an animated grid of customer testimonial cards with star ratings, quotes, product tags, and author avatars using IntersectionObserver for scroll-triggered visibility.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: In-memory React context providing cart state (items, open/close drawer) with add, remove, update quantity, and clear operations, plus computed totals for item count and amount.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: Session-storage-backed React context for cart state using string-based product IDs, with add, remove, update quantity, clear operations, and an isCartOpen toggle.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing admin access control when a token is present and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including admin checks, product CRUD, orders, site settings, user profiles, shopping cart sessions, and payment gateway configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Custom hook that loads the Razorpay payment gateway, opens a checkout modal with order details, and navigates to success or failure pages based on payment outcome.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display and Lato), and defines CSS custom properties for the storefront and admin panel color palettes in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
An admin dashboard showing key stats (revenue, orders, products, users) along with bar and pie charts for revenue trends and order fulfillment status.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: An admin login page that authenticates via Internet Identity, then claims and verifies admin status before redirecting to the admin dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin page for viewing and managing customer orders, with filtering by payment/fulfillment status, search, sorting, stats summary cards, and an order detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin page for managing the product catalog, supporting search, status-based stats, add/edit via a form modal, and delete with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page for configuring store name, contact email, announcement banner, Razorpay key, and WhatsApp number, with save actions and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin page that lists registered users with search by name or principal, displays a summary table, and opens a detail modal on row click.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Shopping cart page that displays cart items with quantity controls and removal options, and triggers Razorpay checkout for the total order amount.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping details via a form and initiates a Stripe checkout session, redirecting the user to the Stripe-hosted payment URL.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The main landing page that composes a hero section with CTA buttons alongside FeaturedProducts, Benefits, Testimonials, and AboutAyurveda components.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: A static page shown after a failed payment, displaying an error message with links to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: A static confirmation page shown after a successful payment, thanking the user and providing links to continue shopping or go home.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Displays full details for a single product fetched by ID, including image, quantity selector, add-to-cart, and Razorpay buy-now functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: A product listing page with search, category, and status filters that queries all products and renders them as a grid of ProductCard components.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting numbers as Indian Rupee currency strings and converting nanosecond bigint timestamps to human-readable dates.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Exports a static array of sample ProductInput objects (face packs and powders) used to seed the product catalog with demo data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the Nature Glow frontend, defining dark mode, content paths, a custom Ayurvedic brand color palette (forest, sage, golden, bark, cream, terracotta), admin-specific color tokens, custom fonts (Lato, Playfair Display), shadows, and keyframe animations including Ken Burns effect.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the Nature Glow project at schema version 1.0.0, recording one existing feature that replaces the hero section background image with a generated static asset while preserving all overlays and animations.
